items.tier2: Wholesalers, mobile handsets sales and others

notes: Source: Telefónica Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed February 27, 2025. Segment revenue composition table shows FY 2024 revenue by operating segment and by business line (Fixed/Mobile); Spain is provided with an alternative split (Retailers vs. Wholesalers, mobile handsets sales and others). Figures extracted in millions of euros and converted to billions. Lines labeled 'Others and inter-segment eliminations' (including the €39m within Germany and €1,382m at Group level) were excluded per instruction. No explicit YoY % by business line was disclosed in the 20-F; therefore yoy_pct is set to null. See 20-F PDF: composition of segment revenues and Spain detail. ([telefonica.com](https://www.telefonica.com/en/wp-content/uploads/sites/5/2025/02/20F-2024.pdf))
